message.content:
**Answer:**  
The most recent common ancestor of a lion (*Panthera leo*) and a zebra (*Equus quagga*) is the ancestor of the clade **Laurasiatheria**, which contains the orders Carnivora (lions) and Perissodactyla (zebras). This ancestor lived roughly **90 million years ago** during the Late Cretaceous, before the diversification of the modern orders within Laurasiatheria.
